## Key points {.unnumbered}

- A data frame holds equal-length columns that can have different types.
- Use `str()`, `dim()`, `nrow()` and `ncol()` to inspect its structure.
- Use `[[` or `$` to extract a column as a vector; `students[1]` keeps a data frame.
- In `students[rows, columns]`, the comma separates row and column selections.
